description: Figure 7 is a grouped bar chart illustrating a comparison of outcomes across language families, with bars indicating whether “mBERT” is better, “XLM-R” is better, or performance is the “same,” as indicated by the legend titled “better.” The horizontal axis contains the language-family categories (left to right: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, Uralic), and the vertical axis is labeled “task count” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40 with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. For each language family, three adjacent bars are shown: a light-blue bar for mBERT, a darker blue bar for XLM-R, and a light-green bar for same; approximate heights are IE-Baltic (mBERT ~0, XLM-R ~10, same ~7), IE-Germanic (~4, ~18, ~22), IE-Indic (~0, ~5, ~4), IE-Romance (~4, ~13, ~30), IE-Slavic (~12, ~39, ~28), IE-other (~1, ~6, ~8), Isolate (~0, ~5, ~1), Semitic (~0, ~7, ~0), and Uralic (~1, ~14, ~5). The bars are not visually stacked and appear uniformly styled without special highlighting or annotations, and the category order follows the listed language-family labels rather than an apparent sorting by bar height.
